theater: 洞庭湖西岸沚江與龍陽水寨

battle.name: 下沚江之戰
battle.theater: 洞庭湖西岸沚江與龍陽水寨
battle.brief: 建炎四年至紹興元年，洞庭湖楊幺義軍與南宋水軍在沚江相持。宋廷以程昌寓主剿，水軍駕高宣所造車船二十餘艘溯沚江攻夏誠水寨；義軍開寨誘敵、閉門壅水，令車船擱淺焚毀，官軍大潰。此役是水寨攻守與船上火力的較量，卡面希臘火所代表的燃燒劑，對應的正是宋船上的猛火油與火藥火器。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 下沚江之戰是一場南宋朝廷與洞庭湖楊幺義軍之間的內戰，交戰地點在洞庭湖西岸的沚江水網與龍陽（今湖南漢壽）一帶。南宋一方是宋高宗朝廷直轄的湖南宣撫司與鼎澧鎮撫使這套指揮系統：主將程昌寓兼知鼎州，節制鼎州、澧州、常德一帶的官軍步卒與水軍；軍中除少數受過訓練的禁軍殘部與招募兵外，大量是各路新募、招撫與收編的散兵，水軍主力則是江南、江西調來的漕船改裝而成，另有泉州、廣州所造船隻徵用。義軍一方不是國家，而是由鍾相、楊幺起家的洞庭漁民與湖洲墾戶組成的武裝，首領楊幺坐鎮水寨，沚江的夏誠水寨由夏誠主持，寨中依《宋史》說法「隨處泊船、隨處有水」，水陸相通、舟楫不絕，並能集中數萬之眾與數百條船。兩造在湖汊交錯的澤國中爭的不是城池，而是水寨的存廢與湖面的航運控制權：義軍卡住洞庭，朝廷往來江淮的漕船與糧道便多一分險情；朝廷若要打通江淮與荊湘的轉運線，就必須先把沚江、龍陽一帶的水寨拔掉。這場衝突也因此是南渡初期「朝廷的船隊對義軍的湖寨」這一對抗形式的第一件大型樣本。
countriesEn: The Battle of Xiazhijiang was a civil war between the court of Song Gaozong and the Yang Mo insurgents in the Dongting Lake basin, fought along the waterways of the Xiazhijiang river and around Longyang (present-day Hanshou in Hunan). On the Song side stood the military administration of the Hunan pacification commission and the Ding-Li pacification office: the commander Cheng Changyu, who concurrently served as governor of Dingzhou, held authority over the garrison infantry and river flotilla of Dingzhou, Li Zhou and Changde, and his troops consisted of a small core of trained imperial guard survivors and recruited men, swamped by disbanded troops, surrendered bands and newly enlisted locals; the strength of his flotilla consisted of grain junks converted for war out of the waterways of Jiangnan and Jiangxi, together with hulls requisitioned from the shipyards of Quanzhou and Guangzhou. The other side was not a state but an armed community of lake fishermen and marsh cultivators that had grown out of the rising begun by Zhong Xiang and Yang Mo; Yang Mo was the acknowledged leader and sat in his strongholds, Xia Cheng commanded the stockade on the Xiazhijiang, and as the Song History puts it, they could moor their boats anywhere and there was water everywhere, holding several tens of thousands of men and several hundred craft. What the two sides fought over in this maze of channels was not walled towns but the survival of the water stockades and command of the lake's navigation: while the insurgents held the Dongting, the court's grain route into and out of the Huai and Yangtze ran constant risk, and if the court wanted to keep the supply line between Jianghuai and Jingxiang open, it first had to pull the stockades at Xiazhijiang and Longyang out of the water. The clash is therefore the first large-scale example of the confrontation that shaped the early Southern Song: the court's fleet against the insurgents' lake stockades.
people: 關鍵人物有四層。義軍方面，鍾相是起義的發起人，建炎三年（1129）以漁民身分在洞庭湖聚眾起事，打出「等貴賤、均賦役」的旗號；建炎四年（1130）春，宋軍擒獲並殺死鍾相，首級曾送朝廷請功。楊麼接過人馬，繼續以洞庭蘆洲為根據地，是義軍的實際領袖，部眾多由漁民、佃戶、流亡者與逃兵組成。夏誠是沚江水寨的主事者，此役中正是由他主持開寨誘敵、壅水焚舟的戰術。朝廷方面，鼎澧鎮撫使程昌寓（又作程昌㝢）領軍進剿，急於求功而輕敵，兵敗後以斬造車船的匠師高宣謝罪，自身也遭貶斥。匠師高宣是《宋史》為之立傳的舟師技師，他改造的車船原本就是為攻洞庭水寨而造，卻成了義軍縱火的好材料；兵敗後朝廷一度治其罪，直到後來重新起用改造車船平定洞庭，這門手藝才重新獲得信任。紹興二年（1132），岳飛率師進軍洞庭，以改裝車船施放火藥火器攻破水寨，義軍主將楊幺被自己的部將擒住，送潭州斬首，餘眾或散或降，洞庭起義才告平定；部將牛皋等人在此役中出力甚多，而敗退的宋軍在收拾殘局時，把大批裝備與糧秣丟在了沚江兩岸。
peopleEn: Four layers of actors matter here. On the insurgent side, Zhong Xiang, a fisherman by origin, raised a revolt among the Dongting channels in 1129 under the banner of levelling rank and equalising levies; in the spring of 1130 the Song troops captured him and put him to death, and his head was carried to the capital to claim credit. Yang Mo took over the bands, kept the reed islands of the Dongting as his base, and was the acknowledged leader of the insurgents, whose following was drawn from fishermen, tenant farmers, vagrants and deserters. Xia Cheng ran the Xiazhijiang stockade, and it was he who organised the tactics of this battle: opening the gates to lure the enemy in, damming the water, burning the ships. On the court's side, Cheng Changyu (also written in the variant form Cheng Chang-yu), appointed pacification commissioner of Ding-Li, led the punitive expedition; eager for credit and contemptuous of the enemy, he made his apology by executing Gao Xuan, the master shipwright whose carriage-ships had been built for exactly this assault, and Cheng himself was later demoted. Gao Xuan is the shipwright given a biography in the Song History: the carriage-ships he rebuilt were designed to break the lake stockades, and they turned out to be perfect fuel for the insurgents' fire; after the defeat the court punished him, and only when the same hulls were refitted and used to settle the Dongting was the craft trusted again. In 1132 Yue Fei marched into the Dongting, broke the stockades with converted carriage-ships carrying gunpowder incendiaries, and Yang Mo was seized by his own subordinates and beheaded at Tanzhou; the ordinary troops surrendered or scattered, men such as Niu Gao did much of the hard work in that campaign, and the defeated Song force, in gathering up what was left, abandoned a great deal of equipment and baggage along both banks of the Xiazhijiang.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘火——配在銅管裡的燃燒劑，配方屬於帝國的機密。希臘火本身出現在下沚江的水面上是不會成立的：它是七世紀地中海東方的海戰武器，宋廷既無配方亦無銅管裝置，兩造都沒有這種東西。但它在本卡的體系裡代表的是一整類水戰燃燒器材，而這恰恰是湖上水寨攻防的關鍵。宋代已把火用在水戰上：《武經總要》（1044）載有以猛火油灌入瓶罐、擲出或以機械拋射的燃燒法，也載有火矢、火箭這類易燃油料的可燃兵器，稍後更出現以火藥裝填、可擲可射的霹靂火球一類火器；到紹興年間，宋軍已能把火藥火器裝上船。真正決定下沚江勝負的裝備是車船：高宣所造，底平而寬，兩側裝水轉輪以人力踏動，船上起樓如城，設弩矢與火器，一艘可載數百人，編隊航行時以輪代櫓、載火藥與弓弩逼近水寨。義軍的裝備則全為湖上所便：裝猛火油與火炬的小艇、能快速轉向的走舸、壅塞水道用的木柵與泥袋，以及分布各水寨的舟楫。火在這一役裡兩度出現：一次是義軍用火燒毀擱淺的車船，一次是三年後岳飛的車船用火藥火器反燒義軍水寨。希臘火在這場戰爭裡的位置，就是這條「火在船上決定水寨歸屬」的技術譜系上的一個源頭節點。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is Greek fire, a burning compound poured through bronze tubing whose recipe was a secret of the empire. Greek fire was not present on the waters of the Xiazhijiang and could not have been: it was a seventh-century naval weapon of the eastern Mediterranean, and the Song court had neither the recipe nor the bronze siphon, so neither side owned anything of the kind. What it represents in this card's system is a whole class of incendiary material for water fighting, and that is exactly what decided the contest over the lake stockades. The Song had already put fire to use on water: the Wujing Zongyao of 1044 records the practice of filling jars with fierce fire oil (crude petroleum) and hurling or machine-throwing them, and also records fire arrows and other incendiary missiles; a little later came gunpowder-filled bombs such as the thunder-crash fireball, and by the Shaoxing years the Song fleet was carrying gunpowder weapons on board. The equipment that truly decided the outcome at Xiazhijiang was the carriage-ship: built by Gao Xuan, flat-bottomed and broad, fitted with water wheels turned by human tread on either side, carrying a tower like a city wall on deck with crossbows and fire weapons, each hull able to carry several hundred men, and in formation sailing on wheels instead of oars while approaching the stockade under covering fire. The insurgents' equipment was whatever the lake favoured: small boats loaded with fierce fire oil and torches, light galleys that could turn quickly, timber palisades and mud sacks for damming the channels, and the war craft distributed among the stockades. Fire appears twice in this story: once the insurgents burn the grounded carriage-ships, and three years later Yue Fei's carriage-ships burn the insurgents' stockades with gunpowder incendiaries. Greek fire's place in this war is that of a source node in the technical lineage of fire carried on board deciding who owns a stockade.
tactics: 宋軍的戰法是以船代城、分段進逼。程昌寓把二十餘艘車船編成前鋒，溯沚江而上，兩岸由步卒與弓弩手護衛，後方以漕船載糧械隨行，試圖以車船的望樓與弩火壓制水寨寨牆，然後由登寨士卒強攻。義軍對付水寨的辦法完全相反：先把水道收窄、築壅蓄水，夏誠命人大開寨門，佯作潰退，把車船隊引入寨前狹窄汊道；待宋船盡入，隨即閉門、掘開蓄水之壅，令水位在短時間內急降，寬而平的車船便在淤泥與淺灘上擱淺；同時以小艇上的火炬、猛火油與火矢四面擲燒，岸上步卒用長桿火炬近火，火箭順風射入船板。水寨外圍還預置了攔截用的舟楫與障礙，專候宋軍殘部潰退時截殺。義軍全盛之時講究「陸耕水戰」，船隊不與官軍硬拼，專以遊擊與死守消耗官軍的人力與糧秣。官軍的弱點在於指揮與水手的素質：車船造得再大，操縱者若不熟水性、潮汐與湖汊地形，一次失手就全隊進退不得；此役宋軍正是輸在進寨過深、退路被自己堵死，潰散時爭先搶船，士卒落水與被俘者極多。
tacticsEn: The Song plan was to turn ships into moving siege works and advance in stages. Cheng Changyu formed his twenty-odd carriage-ships into the vanguard and pushed up the Xiazhijiang, with infantry and crossbowmen guarding both banks and grain junks carrying supplies in the rear, hoping to pin the stockade wall with the elevation and crossbow fire of the carriage-ships' towers and then storm it with boarding troops. The insurgents did the opposite: they first narrowed the channel and dammed the water, and Xia Cheng ordered the stockade gates flung wide in a feigned rout, drawing the ship formation into the narrow reach in front of the stockade. Once the Song hulls were inside, the gates were shut and the dam opened; the water level dropped sharply within a day or two, and the broad flat-bottomed carriage-ships grounded on mud and shoals. At the same time torches, fierce fire oil and fire arrows were thrown from small boats, men on shore lit the decks with long-shafted torches, and rockets were fired into the planking on the wind. Obstructions and intercepting craft had been laid in advance outside the stockade, waiting for the Song retreat. At their height the insurgents fought ploughing on land and fighting on water, never meeting the government fleet head on, wearing down the army's manpower and supplies with harassment and stubborn defence. The court's weakness lay in command and in the quality of the hands on the oars: however large the carriage-ship, if the crew knew neither the water, the tides nor the lake's channels, one mistake locked the whole formation in. That is exactly how the Song lost, advancing too deep into the stockade and blocking their own retreat, and when the line broke the men fought for the boats, so many were drowned or taken.
data: 可核的數字有限，以下只列較有依據者。時間：義軍起於建炎三年（1129），鍾相在建炎四年（1130）春被擒殺，下沚江交戰在紹興元年（1131）正月前後，紹興二年（1132）楊幺被擒、洞庭平定，故此役跨度約兩年。船數：程昌寓投入的車船，據《宋史·高宣傳》等記載為二十餘艘。兵員：朝廷奏報與後世敘述常稱義軍有眾數萬、舟船數百，數字明顯有誇大；較可靠的說法是義軍在洞庭各水寨能出動的舟楫以百計、兵力以萬計，足以封鎖湖面，並能在任何一處集中兵力。官軍損失方面，記載多稱車船盡毀、士卒死者甚眾、溺死者以千計，各家奏報數字互相矛盾；較可確定的是宋軍當日損失了全部二十餘艘車船與隨行漕船的一批，而不是全軍覆沒。距離：沚江在洞庭湖西岸，自鼎州（今常德）水路上溯至龍陽（今漢壽）約二百里，車船隊行數日。水文是關鍵變數：洞庭在冬季與早春為枯水期，湖水經沚江與內湖之間的汊道吞吐，蓄水與洩水之間水位差極大，開渠一兩日即可讓淺灘的水深改變數尺。城池：義軍一度使潭州、鼎州、澧州三面受壓，朝廷在湖內的據點只剩沿江與沿澧水的一線。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and only the better documented ones are given. Timing: the revolt began in 1129, Zhong Xiang was captured and killed in the spring of 1130, the clash at Xiazhijiang fell around the first month of Shaoxing 1 (1131), and Yang Mo was taken and the Dongting settled in 1132, so the campaign spans about two years. Ships: the number of carriage-ships Cheng Changyu committed is given as a little over twenty in the Song History biography of Gao Xuan and in similar sources. Numbers of troops: court memorials and later narratives habitually speak of tens of thousands of insurgents and several hundred boats, figures plainly inflated; the sounder statement is that the insurgents could muster on the order of a hundred craft and several thousand men from the stockades of the lake, enough to seal the water and to concentrate force at any point. On the Song losses the sources say the carriage-ships were destroyed and many men drowned or killed, with various numbers contradicting one another; what can be fixed is that the Song lost all twenty-odd carriage-ships and a batch of accompanying grain junks that day, and this was not the annihilation of the entire army. Distance: the Xiazhijiang lies on the western shore of the Dongting, roughly two hundred li by water upstream from Dingzhou (modern Changde) to Longyang (modern Hanshou), a passage the ship formation took several days to make. Hydrology was the decisive variable: the Dongting is at low water in winter and early spring, and the lake breathes through the channels between the Xiazhijiang and the inner waters, so the difference between impounded and released water is very large; cutting or filling a single channel could change the depth over the shoals by several feet within a day or two. Fortresses: the insurgents at one point put pressure on Tanzhou, Dingzhou and Li Zhou from several sides, and the court's remaining footholds in the lake were reduced to a line along the Yangtze and along the Lishui.
cause: 起義的根子在南宋初年江南與荊湖的秩序真空。建炎南渡之後，朝廷的地盤、兵源與財賦都靠東南一線，洞庭一帶官府力量薄弱，卻同時要負擔軍糧、軍船與丁夫的徵發，漁民、佃戶與蘆洲墾戶被各色苛斂與差役壓得無以為生；建炎三年以來江淮戰事頻仍，逃兵、饑民與散兵大量流入湖區，兵為民所募、民因兵而得生，義軍於是有了兵源。直接導火線是鍾相在建炎三年聚眾起事，打出「等貴賤、均賦役」的旗號，在湖汊之間建立水上聚落，響應者很快達數萬；建炎四年春鍾相被宋軍擒殺後，朝廷沒有改以安撫為主，反而起用程昌寓為鼎澧鎮撫使，準備以水軍攻其必救——用車船直搗水寨。這一政策本身就是衝突升級的關鍵：朝廷以為水寨孤立、舟船吃重、官軍船堅，可以一舉拔除；義軍則得到示範，知道官軍會來，而且會靠水而來，於是把沚江的寨防修成專為應付大型船隊而設的陷阱。程昌寓求功心切，輕敵冒進，最終把一次可以用水寨慢慢消耗的攻勢，變成了全軍押上的冒險。
causeEn: The roots of the rising lay in the vacuum of order in Jiangnan and Jinghu in the early Southern Song. After the move south in 1127, the court had territory, soldiers and revenue on one thin line in the southeast, while around the Dongting its administrative power was thin even though it bore the levy of military grain, war boats and conscripted labour; fishermen, tenant farmers and marsh cultivators were crushed by assorted exactions and corvee, and from 1129 the fighting in the Huai and Yangtze sent deserters, famine refugees and scattered soldiers flooding into the lake region, where soldiers were recruited from the people and the people lived off soldiering, and that is where the insurgents found their manpower. The immediate spark was Zhong Xiang's rising in 1129 under the banner of levelling rank and equalising levies, which built floating settlements among the channels and drew tens of thousands of followers; after he was captured and killed in the spring of 1130 the court did not switch to a policy of conciliation, but appointed Cheng Changyu pacification commissioner of Ding-Li and prepared to attack the insurgents where they could not help themselves, striking the stockades directly with river craft. That policy itself was the key to the escalation: the court assumed the stockades were isolated, that heavy flat-bottomed hulls and well-built government ships would carry the day, and that the nests could be taken in one stroke. The insurgents were given a demonstration, that the court would come and that it would come by water, and so they built the defences of the Xiazhijiang as a trap made specifically for large ship formations. Cheng Changyu's eagerness for credit and his underestimation of the enemy turned an attack that might have been bled dry into a gamble on the whole army.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是洞庭湖的水域秩序更長期地落到義軍手裡，直到紹興二年才被結束。技術上的意義更大：車船在這次慘敗中被否定，卻也因此被重新檢討、重新設計——平底闊船加裝火藥火器的做法，隨後在對楊幺的戰役中驗證成功，岳飛正是用改裝車船施放火砲攻破水寨，義軍溺死者無算，楊幺被部將所擒，斬於潭州，洞庭自此歸於朝廷控制。這一役也把「火在船上決定水寨歸屬」的道理擺到了桌面：猛火油、火矢、火藥火器從此常駐南宋水軍，後來采石之戰（1161）宋軍用樓船、霹靂炮對付金軍戰船時，用的仍是同一條技術線的延伸。人事上，高宣被冤斬後朝廷最終平反並再度起用他，說明宋代對技術匠師的功罪評價長期受軍政考績牽動。編制上，義軍降卒被岳飛挑選精銳編入車軍，成為後來岳家軍兵源的一部分，洞庭水寇的問題也自此不再是南宋內部的主要隱患；湖南一帶的蘆洲屯田、漁利與湖運秩序重新回到官府手上，兩浙、江西通往湖廣的漕運線恢復了安全與常態。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was that the insurgent grip on the waters of the Dongting lasted longer still, until it was ended in 1132. The technical meaning is larger still. The carriage-ship was discredited in the disaster, and for that very reason it was re-examined and redesigned: the flat-bottomed broad hull with gunpowder incendiaries was proven in the campaign that followed against Yang Mo, when Yue Fei broke the stockades with converted carriage-ships firing gunpowder weapons, the insurgents drowned in numbers, Yang Mo was taken by his own men and beheaded at Tanzhou, and the Dongting returned to the court's hands. The battle also laid the proposition that fire carried on board decides who owns a stockade: fierce fire oil, fire arrows and gunpowder weapons became standing equipment of the Song fleet, and the same technical line reappeared at the Battle of Caishi in 1161, when Song tower-ships and thunder-crash bombards faced the Jin fleet. In personnel terms, Gao Xuan's wrongful execution was eventually reversed and he was put back to work, showing how the Song court's judgement of technical craftsmen was long governed by military promotion rosters. In organisation, insurgents who surrendered were screened by Yue Fei and folded into his carriage troops, becoming part of the later Yue family's manpower, and the problem of lake bandits ceased to be a principal internal danger of the Southern Song; the marsh cultivation, fishery and lake transport of the Hunan region returned to official hands, and the grain route from Liangzhe and Jiangxi into Huguang regained its regularity and safety.
result: 紹興元年正月前後，程昌寓率官軍溯沚江進攻，車船二十餘艘為前驅，直取夏誠水寨。夏誠大開寨門佯作不守，把車船引入狹窄水道；宋船盡入之後，寨門閉合，蓄水之壅被掘開，洞庭枯水期的高落差在數日之內把寬平的車船擱死在淤泥淺灘上；義軍小艇上的火炬、猛火油與火矢隨即四面投擲，岸上步卒以長桿火炬近火，車船盡焚，官軍士卒落水被俘者甚眾，大軍當夜潰散，程昌寓僅以身免，退回鼎州。朝廷以斬造車船的匠師高宣謝罪，主將遭貶斥，所部四散，義軍則乘勢占據洞庭各處水寨，兵力與船隻都有增加，局勢反而更壞。真正的收尾發生在紹興二年：岳飛率軍進軍洞庭，改用平底車船並加施火藥火器，攻破夏誠與楊幺的水寨，義軍大潰，楊幺為部下所擒，送潭州處死，餘眾或降或散，洞庭起義平定。這一戰的勝負說明：卡面所代表的希臘火一類燃燒技術固然改變了水寨攻防的規則，但決定下沚江歸屬的，還是水寨的地形、水位與舟船的操縱——火要有人把它送上船、送到寨前，才算數。
resultEn: Around the first month of Shaoxing 1, Cheng Changyu led the government force up the Xiazhijiang with more than twenty carriage-ships as spearhead against Xia Cheng's stockade. Xia Cheng threw the stockade gates wide in pretence of disorder and drew the ships into the narrow reach; once the Song hulls were inside, the gates were shut and the impoundment opened, and in the low-water season the great difference in level left the broad flat-bottomed carriage-ships dead on mud and shoals within days. Torches, fierce fire oil and fire arrows came raining from the insurgents' small boats, men on shore applied long-shafted torches at close range, and the carriage-ships burned; many soldiers drowned or were taken, the line broke the same night, and Cheng Changyu got away with his life and retreated to Dingzhou. The court made atonement by executing Gao Xuan, the master shipwright; the commander was demoted, his command scattered, and the insurgents, emboldened, occupied stockades all over the Dongting with more men and more boats, so the situation grew worse. The real ending came in 1132: Yue Fei marched into the Dongting with flat-bottomed carriage-ships carrying gunpowder incendiaries, broke Xia Cheng's and Yang Mo's stockades, scattered the insurgents, had Yang Mo seized by his own men and beheaded at Tanzhou, and brought the Dongting rising to an end. The verdict of the battle is that an incendiary technology in the Greek fire line did reshape the rules of water fighting against stockades, but what decided who held Xiazhijiang was the terrain of the stockades, the level of the water and the handling of the boats: fire counts only if someone carries it aboard and brings it up to the gate.
